title: Aspirin for secondary prevention
text: Low-dose aspirin reduces the risk of recurrent myocardial infarction in patients with prior coronary events.

title: Metformin and renal function
text: Metformin can be continued in mild chronic kidney disease with dose adjustment and monitoring of eGFR.

title: Statin-associated muscle symptoms
text: Myalgia is the most common adverse effect reported by patients taking statins.

title: Vitamin D and falls
text: Vitamin D supplementation has a modest effect on fall prevention in older adults with deficiency.

title: Influenza vaccination timing
text: Annual influenza vaccination is recommended before the start of the flu season.

title: Hypertension lifestyle changes
text: Reducing sodium intake and regular exercise lower blood pressure in most patients.
